# Proto-Thaven
Proto-Thaven are very uncommon, due to their unique biology attaching modifications this extentive to any Thaven can be quite costly, not to mention the impact it has on their moods. Thus they are usually only done by wealthy Thavens, or those that do not mind spending the extra credits.
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - They suffocate [color=#ffa500]100% faster[/color]. - Due to their unique biology, they take [color=#ffa500]10% more damage from blunt, slash, pierce, and genetic, 15% more from heat, and 20% more damage from radiation,[/color]. - Additionally, their aquatic ancestry allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]55% less damage from cold and 10% less from poison.[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1fb0ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Thanks to their martial arts prowess they deal [color=red]18[/color] stamina damage with their unarmed attacks, but deal [color=#ffa500]no physical damage and are 50% slower[/color]. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Moods
The Thaven have a unique brain structure, similar to a positronic brain, and thus have "Moods" which affect them similarly to a borg's Laws.
- Moods are compulsions that Thaven should try to follow. If your mood [color=#ff0000]explicitly[/color] requires you to break server rules, you may. \n - Absence of a relevant mood is not an excuse to break server rules. If you do not have a relevant mood, the server rules still apply. \n - A vague mood does not normally let you break server rules. Ahelp first if you are confused, or believe your mood gives you reason to break server rules. - If a mood can not be satisfied, it causes distress to Thaven. This distress is not extreme, and does no inherently justify rule breaking, but may allow gradual escalation that does not cross into murder or mass sabotage. - Attempting to break the law in a way that directly leads to you being able to fulfill a mood may be allowed, within reason; \n - Breaking into a department to obtain something or make an order in Cargo that they refuse would be allowed. \n - Murdering the Chief Engineer to use their stamp to approve paperwork giving you access to a room in Engineering would not be allowed. - Some leniency for Rule 13 may be allowed based on mood, but those who have been hired to Command, Security, and NanoTrasen jobs on stations are expected to be experienced in their work, meaning they have earned this rank while managing their moods for potentially years. They should understand how to juggle the responsibilities of their jobs with the fickle and often arbitrary compulsions of their moods in a way that would not get them fired.
## Mood Swings Thaven brains are susceptible to fluctuations in electromagnetic fields. As a result, their ability to synchronize and regulate their Moods tends to degrade with extended exposure to the cosmic rays that permeate space stations. [color=#ffa500]It also renders them vulnerable to EM fields generated by Cryptographic Sequencers, or EMAG,[/color] which can give them additional, often severely debilitating moods.
## Thaveyan and Trinary The Thaven language, known as Thaveyan, is composed of long sentences that are strung together into melodies. It is often described as elegant and pleasant, able to be spoken by anyone capable of singing. Due to their shared aquatic origins, Thaven are able to understand space carps. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Thaven are a long lived species, reaching adulthood at 21 years of age and being capable of living up to 300 years. They pick their own names, changing them often throughout their lives, typically after a single virtue they hold dear.
